Overview

Bark connects customers with local professionals across home services, business support, health and wellness, and events. My work covers the customer web app, marketing pages, and Contentful CMS, with ownership across both engineering and business requirements.

My contributions

  • Build customer-facing features and marketing experiences using React and React Router within an Nx monorepo and micro-frontend architecture.
  • Work with marketing stakeholders to turn their requirements into Contentful CMS enhancements.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and report findings and proposed fixes to the squad leader and stakeholders.
  • Optimize Core Web Vitals and SEO, and use Heap to record and understand user interactions.
  • Use AI tools for implementation, debugging, code review, and security maintenance, with human review.

Results

A landing page feature I worked on increased the interaction rate from 19% to 38%.

I also created an internal Claude skill to help patch vulnerabilities across 10+ repositories each week, reducing manual security maintenance.
